Write 4 emails of category `follow_up`, one per slot below, each with its label as described in the brief. Every email must be different in sender, organisation, products and wording.

Slots:
1. English reply in an existing thread ('Re:'), chasing delivery of an earlier order; the earlier PO email is quoted below with '>' lines and mentions the PO number.
2. Bahasa Indonesia, chasing a quotation requested two weeks ago; the original request is forwarded underneath.
3. Vietnamese WITH diacritics, chasing an engineer visit for a broken analyser reported last week.
4. Internal: a Lives Group sales rep in Malaysia chases the MDM team about a customer account request sent last week because they cannot book an order yet; the earlier request is quoted. This is a follow-up, not a new master-data request.

emails.body:
Hi team,

Can you please confirm when the 10 boxes of Dengue NS1 kits under PO TMC-PO-26-0418 will arrive? Our store keeps asking since Monday and we are running low on stock.

Thanks,
Priya Nair
Procurement Executive, Tanjong Medical Centre Pte Ltd
Tel +65 6123 4567

On Tue, 3 Mar 2026 at 10:12, Priya Nair <procurement@tanjongmedical.com.sg.example> wrote:
> Hi Sales,
>
> Please find attached our PO TMC-PO-26-0418. Please deliver 10 boxes of Dengue NS1 kits to our clinic at Tanjong Pagar, delivery by 20 March if possible.
>
> Regards,
> Priya
emails.gist: Customer chases delivery ETA for 10 boxes of Dengue NS1 kits ordered under PO TMC-PO-26-0418.
emails.subject: Re: PO TMC-PO-26-0418 - Dengue NS1 kits
